text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the sale of the following vessels.
Some of these sales may not be final as they may be subject to survey, inspection or other conditions.
Mar Grande - (built 1984) 21,339 dwt sold for $7.5 million.
Forum Cape - (built 1973) 116,181 dwt sold to Indian buyers for $2.9 million at auction in Rotterdam.
Narwal - (built 1985) 67,359 dwt sold for $12.5 to $13.8 million.
Elli B - (built 1980) 61,632 dwt sold to greek buyers for $8.3 million.
Campana - (built 1976) 38,808 dwt sold at auction to mortgagees for $2.81 million.
Hyundai No.17 - (built 1983) 36,788 dwt sold for $9.4 million.
Hua Jin - (built 1981) 30,869 dwt sold to South American buyers for $4.7 million.
Golden Tennyo - (built 1977) 24,738 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $1.7 million.
Jin Ji Ling and sisterships Jian Feng Ling and Mo Xing Ling - all (built 1985) 20,333 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $15 million en-bloc.
Hong Qi 205 - (built 1983) and sister ship Hong Qi 206 both 19,239 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $8 million.
